authority: Hawaii Department of Agriculture and Biosecurity

supersededTextCrossCheck.disposition: Used only for complete pdfplumber text cross-check, then removed from the untracked candidate directory after the current program-linked scan was verified.

review.reviewMethod: Complete page-by-page transcription of the current scan, cross-checked against bundled pdfplumber extraction of the older official text copy and visual rendering of both copies.

contradictions.subject: registered-pdf-versus-current-program-link
contradictions.priorState: The registry pointed directly to a 32417-byte AR-68 text compilation and preserved uncertainty about whether it was the filed official copy.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The current agency program page links a different 810188-byte scanned Chapter-68.pdf. Its list pages match the older text compilation, and page 15 contains the adoption, approval, and August 12, 1992 filing evidence.
contradictions.resolution: The current program-linked scan is the sole operative retained artifact. The older PDF is only a non-operative text-extraction cross-check and no superseded source basis remains in generated Hawaii applicability.

contradictions.subject: program-count-wording
contradictions.priorState: The current program page says more than 79 plant species are designated under Chapter 68.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The complete current program-linked Chapter 68 table contains exactly 79 taxon rows across pages 10 through 14.
contradictions.resolution: All 79 explicit rows are preserved. The wording discrepancy remains an explicit currentness and certification caveat; no unlisted taxon is invented or silently omitted.

contradictions.subject: island-free-language
contradictions.priorState: The official table includes an Islands Free or Relatively Free column and Chapter 68 defines procedures for area designation.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The table does not provide county scope, survey method, effort, time-bounded detection results, or a uniform meaning that supports county absence or not-detected status.
contradictions.resolution: The island column remains contextual only. This review creates state applicability and no island, county, absence, not-detected, or not-applicable determination.

contradictions.subject: historical-taxonomy
contradictions.priorState: The 1992 adopted table includes genus, variety, synonym, source-spelling, and unmatched names.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Forty-eight of 79 rows do not pass the exact current catalog-binomial gate.
contradictions.resolution: All 48 remain blocked for explicit taxonomy review. Rejected or ambiguous rows create no negative evidence.
